title: checkpointGraph
responsibility: Evaluate checkpoint eligibility from one tick snapshot and apply eligible actions in stable order.

inputs.name: conditionMatches.condition
inputs.description: The state field, operator, and expected value for one comparison. `eq` uses strict equality; `gte` and `lte` compare only when both values are numbers.

inputs.name: conditionMatches.state
inputs.description: The state snapshot read at `condition.field` when evaluating the condition. Values are strings, numbers, or booleans, and numeric operators return false if either compared value is not a number.

inputs.name: checkpointEligible.node
inputs.description: The checkpoint whose id, repeatable flag, prerequisites, and conditions are checked. It is eligible only when its completion, prerequisite, and condition checks pass.

examples.title: Open the Door
examples.description: Open the door after reaching the required score.

inputs.name: checkpointEligible.run
inputs.description: The current run supplies completed checkpoint ids and the state used to evaluate prerequisites and conditions. A non-repeatable checkpoint already listed in `completed` is ineligible.

inputs.name: checkpointGraph.run
inputs.description: The initial run supplies the state, completed ids, tick, events, and trace for this evaluation. The returned run is a shallow copy with its state and completed, events, and trace arrays copied before eligible actions are applied.

inputs.name: checkpointGraph.view
inputs.description: The view supplies the checkpoints considered for this evaluation. Eligible checkpoints are sorted by id using `localeCompare` before their actions are applied.

checkpoints.title: Open the Door
checkpoints.description: Open the door after reaching the required score.

outputs.name: conditionMatches
outputs.description: True when the condition uses strict equality and the values match, or when both values are numbers and the selected `gte` or `lte` comparison succeeds. Nonnumeric ordered comparisons return false.

outputs.name: checkpointEligible
outputs.description: True when the checkpoint is repeatable or not already completed, every prerequisite id is completed, and every condition matches the run state.

outputs.name: checkpointGraph
outputs.description: A copied run after checkpoints eligible against the initial run have been applied in id order using `localeCompare`. After each applied checkpoint, its id is added if needed and a trace entry is appended; events and trace are truncated to their last 1000 entries.
